0.0.n: Names the destination of the trip.

0.1.n: Marks the destination where arrival will happen.

0.2.n: Makes the airport destination the topic, following に.

0.4.n: Introduces an estimated amount of time.

0.5.n: 分 counts minutes; 10分 is read じゅっぷん or じっぷん.

0.6.n: Follows a quantity to show it is approximate, reinforcing およそ here.

0.7.n: Marks how much time will pass before arrival.

0.8.n: Combines with いたします to form a formal, humble expression for arriving.

0.9.n: Polite form of いたす, the humble alternative to する; with 到着, it announces the speaker’s upcoming arrival.

1.0.n: Signals a transition from the previous announcement to what happens next.

1.2.n: Describes 運転; together they form a phrase for driving safely.

1.3.n: A noun paired with 安全 to describe how the trip will be conducted.

1.4.n: Marks safe driving as the manner in which the service will be provided.

1.5.n: Names the destination, followed by まで to mark the endpoint.

1.6.n: Marks the airport as the endpoint of the journey.

1.7.n: 案内 means guidance; ご adds respectful formality when offering this service to passengers.

1.8.n: Polite form of humble いたす; ご案内いたします respectfully presents the speaker’s service of taking passengers to their destination.

0.lit: As for the airport, in approximately ten minutes or so, we will humbly arrive.
0.tip: 到着いたします is a formal, humble way to say 到着します, common in customer announcements.

1.lit: Well then, with safe driving, we will humbly guide you to the airport.
1.tip: ご案内 here means taking passengers to their destination, not simply giving them directions.
